class.name: SpineMesh2D
class.brief_description: Internal mesh node used by [code]SpineSprite2D[/code] to render one skeleton slot.
class.description: [code]SpineMesh2D[/code] is an internal rendering node. [code]SpineSprite2D[/code] creates one [code]SpineMesh2D[/code] per skeleton slot. Each instance holds deformed vertices, UVs, vertex colors, and indices for its slot. The parent updates mesh data every frame and issues canvas draw commands. Do not add [code]SpineMesh2D[/code] nodes to your scene yourself. Use [code]SpineSprite2D[/code] for gameplay and editor preview. Slot draw order follows skeleton slot order. [code]SpineSlotNode2D[/code] children insert extra nodes into the same draw order when you need custom content on a slot.
